sloka: सूर्ये चास्तं गते रात्रौ देहं संक्षिप्य मारुतिः ।वृषदंशकमात्रः सन् बभूवाद्भुतदर्शनः ॥५-२-४९॥
transliteration: sūrye cāstaṁ gate rātrau dehaṁ saṁkṣipya mārutiḥ ।vṛṣadaṁśakamātraḥ san babhūvādbhutadarśanaḥ ॥5-2-49॥

translations.english: When Sun set, Maruti, the son of the Windgod, reduced himself at night to the small size of a cat, wonderful to behold.
